scripts.dev: PYTHONPATH=. uv run python -m uvicorn src.app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8002 --reload
scripts.worker: PYTHONPATH=. uv run python -m arq src.app.workers.worker.WorkerSettings
scripts.build: PYTHONPATH=. uv run python -m compileall -q src tests scripts
scripts.db:current: PYTHONPATH=. uv run python -m alembic -c alembic.ini current
scripts.db:migrate: PYTHONPATH=. uv run python -m alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.lint: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --extra test ruff check src tests scripts
scripts.test: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --extra test python -m pytest
